title: Adjunction and vanishing for cohomology with support of a sheaf pushed forward from a closed subset
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves three facts about R-H_Z for the inclusion i : Z -> X of a closed subset: it is right adjoint to i_* on the derived level, it recovers K from i_*K, and its higher cohomology sheaves vanish on sheaves pushed forward from Z. The proof derives the adjunction from exactness of i_* together with the derived adjunction criterion applied to the abelian adjunction of sections with support (proof lines 8513-8517), and proves the second statement by representing K by a K-injective complex whose pushforward stays K-injective, so that H_Z(i_*I^bullet) computes R-H_Z(i_*K) and equals I^bullet; the third statement is then the special case of a single sheaf (proof lines 8518-8525). H2: the K-injective bookkeeping is short but is exactly what makes the derived statement follow, and it is not spelled out anywhere else in the section.
